title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
hook_before: Elizabeth Holmes has over one thousand trial files online.
script:
Elizabeth Holmes has one thousand trial files online.
You can now dig through her actual Theranos emails and texts.
Extend engineer Bo Lau built a website recreating her desk.
It packs real slides, texts, and evidence from her federal trial.
You can even read private messages about Theranos blood testing machines.
Would you snoop through her emails?
